name: atlas-code
description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus ten subagents that keep searches, logs, pages and big files out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear. This variant adds coding and documents: review by language, build fixing, tests, verification, planning, shipping, specs, changelogs and the rest, each read only when used.
